column1: # Game profile of Absolum (Switch, base game v0 + update 1.1.2 = v458752). Plays on the Mac and on the iPhone
# FNA (XNA 4 reimplemented in C#) compiled with .NET NativeAOT (NativeAOT-NX), SDL3, FNA3D's NVN driver (FNA3D_Driver_NVN.cpp), Wwise, SDK 18.3.2.

# The shaders are GLSLC outputs in rom:/shaders.nx.bin; the effects (.xnb) carry D3D9 bytecode that MOJOSHADER parses for the parameters. Epic Online Services comes as an NRO (nro/EOSSDK-Switch-Shipping.nro)

# Game name: only a label for profile listings and the Mac window title; the iOS app name is the game name in the base NSP, and the bundle ID comes from the base game title ID (build_ipa.sh / NSP script)
# load order as on Horizon: main, subsdk*, sdk (subsdk2 = NintendoSDK_movie, for FNA3D's video player). Not loaded: subsdk0 (NVIDIA's Vulkan driver) and subsdk1 (NVIDIA's OpenGL driver):
# main imports EGL and Vulkan for SDL3's GL / Vulkan support, but FNA3D renders with NVN, and both drivers program the GPU through NvRm, which the host does not have
# The NPDM declares 16 MB of system resource (virtual address memory), and main never calls SetMemoryHeapSize: everything lives in address regions of the alias region.
# Measured with a 64 GB alias region from boot into the first level (probes on VammManager::AllocateAddressRegion's success path sdk+0x13bf8c, x21 size / x22 address, and the MapPhysicalMemory log):
#   - malloc's StandardAllocator, 40 GB of address space (main+0x28c084; 1.1.1 main+0x28bff4); 2.19 GB used, 1.75 GB of it FNA3D's GPU heap (FNA3D_CreateDevice). stdalloc_cap below gives it 2.5 GB;

#   - the .NET GC's region range: 5 × its hard limit, 768 MB (75% of the 1 GB its GetPhysicalMemoryLimit, main+0x28c08c; 1.1.1 main+0x28bffc, returns), i.e. 3.75 GB. game_env below sets 1.5 GB, which the GC
#     uses from both ends (756 MB from the start, 748 MB from the end, 718 MB mapped into the first level);
#   - a few small regions (bookkeeping, thread-local blocks), under 5 MB.
# With the sdk cuts (node area 62 MB, 32 MB alignment for large regions) they take about 4.1 GB of the 4.375 GB alias region in Engage's 5 GB block (256 MB in front + 4.375 GB alias region
# + 256 MB stack region + 128 MB heap region, never used). The mapped total peaks at 2.9 GB, under the hardware pool
# The .NET runtime takes its settings from the environment (NativeAOT: getenv("DOTNET_…"), hex values); the GC's region range is 1.5 GB instead of 5 × its hard limit (hle_os.c game_env)
# malloc's StandardAllocator over 40 GB gets 2.5 GB on builds without the main cut (hle_svc.c, the host's StandardAllocator cap): the GC's 1.5 GB region comes after it, more than the
# 256 MB the default leaves. With main 1.1.1 rewritten without its cut: 2.5 GB and the GC region at alias +2.59 GB, frame 3,900 in 75 s; the default 4.06 GB aborts at sdk+0x13a684
